pairs.en: Close to the palace lies the historic Al-Koot district, home to [Bayt Al-Bay'ah](/en/attractions/baiah/) — the Al-Mulla family house built by Al-Ahsa's judge, Sheikh Abdulrahman bin Omar Al-Mulla, in 1203 AH / 1789 CE, where the people of Al-Ahsa pledged allegiance to King Abdulaziz in 1913 and joined the Saudi state; today it is a museum.
pairs.zh: 宫殿近旁便是历史悠久的库特区，[效忠之家](/zh/attractions/baiah/)（拜特·拜阿）就在这里。伊斯兰历 1203 年（公元 1789 年），哈萨的法官谢赫阿卜杜勒拉赫曼·本·奥马尔·穆拉（“谢赫”是宗教学者的尊称）建起了这座穆拉家族的宅邸；公元 1913 年，哈萨民众在此向阿卜杜勒阿齐兹国王宣誓效忠，哈萨由此归入沙特版图。宅邸如今辟为博物馆。

pairs.en: In Al-Ahsa, craft is not an exhibit behind glass — it is a set of living trades handed down through families generation after generation
pairs.zh: 在哈萨，手工艺不是玻璃柜里的陈列，而是一门门活着的行当，由一个个家族世代相传

pairs.en: The Hasawi bisht is the cloak of ceremony and standing, and what sets it apart is the Hasawi weave: precise hand embroidery in zari threads coated with gold or silver water.
pairs.zh: 哈萨比什特长袍是身份与重大场合的礼袍，而它的独到之处在于哈萨织造：以镀金或镀银的扎里线手工绣成，针脚细密。

pairs.en: a pottery house where vessels are still shaped from clay in the old manual way and fired in its kilns
pairs.zh: 坊里的器皿至今仍用黏土手工塑成，再入窑烧制，做法一如从前

pairs.en: press coverage records that pottery has endured on this spot for more than six hundred years
pairs.zh: 媒体报道称，此地制陶已延续 600 多年

pairs.en: proof that in the oasis, the palm gives all of itself, from fruit to frond
pairs.zh: 足见在这片绿洲上，椰枣树浑身是宝，从果实到棕榈叶

pairs.en: It also holds a handicrafts academy run by experienced craftspeople who pass their trades to new generations
pairs.zh: 市集里还有一所传授手工艺的学院，由经验丰富的手工艺人主持，把手艺传给新一代

pairs.en: Yes — Dougha Al-Gharash, at the foot of Jabal Al-Qarah, is a visitor stop where you watch the stages of the craft from kneading the clay to the wheel to the kiln, and buy directly from its wares.
pairs.zh: 可以。加拉什家族的杜加陶坊就在卡拉山脚下，是游客游览的一站：从揉泥、陶轮拉坯到入窑烧制，制陶的各道工序都能看到，坊里的陶器也能直接选购。

pairs.en: The three stops fit together naturally
pairs.zh: 这三站正好连成一线

pairs.en: An honest gift from Al-Ahsa comes out of the oasis itself: from its palms, its citrus and the hands of its artisans.
pairs.zh: 哈萨最实在的礼物都出自绿洲本身：它的椰枣树、柑橘，以及手艺人的一双手。

pairs.en: Hasawi Lime and the Oasis Pantry
pairs.zh: 哈萨青柠与绿洲人家的常备

pairs.en: Khalas is the master variety — golden as fresh rutab in summer, amber as dried dates at season's end
pairs.zh: 哈拉斯（Khalas）是当家品种——夏天是金黄的软熟鲜椰枣（Rutab），季末则是琥珀色的全熟干果

pairs.en: From the same pantry come date syrup, which sweetens the local dishes, and date bread sprinkled with nigella seed.
pairs.zh: 同样是绿洲人家的常备，还有为本地菜增甜的椰枣糖浆，以及撒着黑种草籽的椰枣面包。

pairs.en: The Hasawi lime (Bin Zuhairi) is among the most celebrated produce of Al-Ahsa's groves
pairs.zh: 哈萨青柠（本地品种名 Bin Zuhairi）是哈萨果园里最有名的出产之一

pairs.en: Entry is free, and evening is its best hour.
pairs.zh: 免费入场，傍晚是它最好的时候。

pairs.en: And the cluster of adjoining souqs in Hofuf's heart
pairs.zh: 还有胡富夫市中心的那几座市集，彼此相邻，连成一片

pairs.en: The heritage souqs come alive in the evening
pairs.zh: 遗产市集要到傍晚才热闹起来

pairs.en: end the journey with a suitcase that carries the oasis home
pairs.zh: 为这趟旅程收个尾——让行李箱替您把绿洲带回家

pairs.en: A sea of palms with a mountain in it.
pairs.zh: 椰枣林如海，海中立着一座山

pairs.en: This is the green, slow, lived-in chapter of a Saudi journey
pairs.zh: 在一趟沙特之行里，这是绿的、慢的、有人过日子的那一章

pairs.en: a heritage that is still someone's daily life rather than a staged set
pairs.zh: 还有一份遗产——它至今仍是当地居民的日常生活，而不是为游客搭起的布景

pairs.en: If your idea of travel is ticking monuments off a list, Al-Ahsa will still fill two rewarding days.
pairs.zh: 如果您心目中的旅行是照着景点清单一处处打卡，哈萨也能给您两天不虚此行的日子。

pairs.en: water, palms and people have kept the same appointment for thousands of years
pairs.zh: 几千年来，水、椰枣树与人一直守着同一个约定

pairs.en: Al-Ahsa is the plural of hisy — sweet water gathered beneath a thin layer of sand, springing up where no one expects it
pairs.zh: “哈萨”（Al-Ahsa）是“希斯”（hisy）的复数——指薄薄一层沙土之下汇聚流淌的甘甜泉水，总在人们意想不到的地方涌出来

pairs.en: Water and wind shaped this rock over thousands of years, carving corridors so narrow the stone almost brushes your shoulders — then suddenly opening onto a high chamber pierced by a thread of light.
pairs.zh: 数千年来，水与风雕琢着山中的岩石，凿出一道道狭窄的石廊——两侧岩壁几乎触及肩头；转过一道弯，眼前豁然开朗，一线天光自石厅高处漏下。

pairs.en: step in at noon in August and an unexpected coolness greets you; step in on a winter night and it feels warm
pairs.zh: 八月正午走进去，迎面是一阵意想不到的清凉；冬夜走进去，留在身上的却是一层暖意

pairs.en: Nor is the mountain a single connected passage.
pairs.zh: 这座山并不是一条贯通到底的通道。

pairs.en: Al-Ahsa's heat rule is to keep open-air stops for morning and sunset, and the caves for the hours in between.
pairs.zh: 哈萨应对暑热的办法，就是把露天的景点留给清晨和日落，把洞穴留给中间的那几个钟头。

pairs.en: Some landmarks you visit to say you've seen them; Jabal Al-Qarah you visit to feel it
pairs.zh: 有些地标，您去是为了说一句“我看过了”。而卡拉山，您去是为了感受它

pairs.en: the corridor narrowing then the chamber opening
pairs.zh: 石廊先收紧，石厅再敞开

pairs.en: A small green fruit whose fragrance reaches you before you see it
pairs.zh: 这是一枚小小的绿色果子，人还没看见，香气就先到了

pairs.en: In this article: what sets the Hasawi lomi apart, when its season falls, how it fills the household pantry and flavours the local kitchen
pairs.zh: 本文要讲的是：哈萨青柠特别在哪里，时令落在什么时候，如何成为绿洲人家的常备，又如何为本地菜肴增香

pairs.en: From Tree to Pantry: Jameed, the Sun-Dried Lime Juice
pairs.zh: 从树上到绿洲人家的常备：日晒青柠汁“贾米德”

pairs.en: Lift the lid of a Hasawi pot and the lomi is there
pairs.zh: 揭开当地人家的锅盖，青柠总在里头

pairs.en: the heritage dish mufallaq is cracked wheat flavoured with lomi and crowned with dates and boiled eggs
pairs.zh: 传统菜式穆法拉格（Mufallaq）则是以青柠提味的碎麦，再缀上椰枣与水煮蛋

pairs.en: Dates are Al-Ahsa's headline; the lomi is its summer signature
pairs.zh: 椰枣是哈萨的招牌，青柠则是它夏天的落款

pairs.en: a small fruit that so distils the taste of the oasis it earned an exhibition of its own
pairs.zh: 小小一枚果子，把绿洲的味道浓缩得这样彻底，也就配得上一场属于自己的展会

pairs.en: The oasis needs no legend to be proud of its lime.
pairs.zh: 绿洲为自己的青柠感到自豪，并不需要一则传说。

pairs.en: Here begins the part where stories multiply and documents thin out, and honesty requires drawing its limits clearly.
pairs.zh: 从这里开始，说法多起来，文献却少下去；诚实的做法，是把界限划清楚。

pairs.en: The lomi's story is incomplete without its greatest danger.
pairs.zh: 不讲它最大的危险，青柠的故事就不完整。

pairs.en: The fruit's very name carries a trace of its journey.
pairs.zh: 这枚果子的名字本身就留着旅途的痕迹。

pairs.en: The significance runs deeper than it looks
pairs.zh: 这条线索的分量比看上去更重

pairs.en: which traced the spread of 17 food crops, the acid lime and the sour orange among them
pairs.zh: 他追溯了 17 种食用作物的传播，来檬与酸橙就在其中

pairs.en: a complete food culture crowned by the custom of jameed
pairs.zh: 还有一整套饮食文化，而这套文化的顶点，正是“贾米德”（jameed）的习俗

pairs.en: No historical document dates its arrival in Al-Ahsa specifically.
pairs.zh: 没有哪份历史文献为它传入哈萨一事定下过年代。

pairs.en: the best available account concerns the immediate neighbourhood, not Al-Ahsa itself
pairs.zh: 现有最可靠的一条说法讲的是紧邻的地区，而不是哈萨本身

pairs.en: Every lomi tree in Al-Ahsa is therefore, by necessity, descended from a tree that arrived from outside.
pairs.zh: 所以哈萨的每一棵青柠树，必然都是从外面来的某棵树的后代。

pairs.en: India was a corridor and a centre of dispersal, not the first homeland.
pairs.zh: 印度是通道，是扩散的中心，却不是最初的家园。

pairs.en: Something worth more than a claim of origin
pairs.zh: 剩下的东西比“原产地”这个名头更可贵

pairs.en: a landrace of low genetic diversity in a region facing a disease that has destroyed a million trees next door
pairs.zh: 一个遗传多样性偏低的地方品种，身处一个正面临病害的地区——而这种病害已经在紧邻的地方毁掉了百万棵树

pairs.en: Anything not stated in the article as settled is open to revision when a new peer-reviewed study appears.
pairs.zh: 凡本文未以定论口吻陈述的内容，都可能因新的同行评议研究而修订。

pairs.en: The fruit that came from afar is today the emblem of the oasis summer.
pairs.zh: 这枚从远方来的果子，如今成了绿洲夏天的象征。

pairs.en: Where four of the cards mention an occasion or a season — Ramadan, winter nights, wedding feasts, tables of hospitality — they describe the dish’s place in the traditions of the Hasawi table, not when it is served to visitors.
pairs.zh: 有四张菜品卡片提到斋月、冬日寒夜、宴席与婚礼、待客的餐桌等场合与时令，这些描述讲的是菜肴在哈萨餐桌传统中扮演的角色，而不是何时向游客供应。

pairs.en: The word itself began as a given name, a shortened form of the Turkish Arslan, meaning lion.

pairs.en: Al-Asfar Lake is one of the twelve components inscribed as part of the Al-Ahsa Oasis site on the UNESCO World Heritage List: a rare expanse of water in the middle of the desert that has become a stopover for migratory birds and a destination for anyone seeking quiet and a wide horizon.
pairs.ar: بحيرة الأصفر أحد المكوّنات الاثني عشر المُدرجة ضمن موقع واحة الأحساء على قائمة اليونسكو للتراث العالمي، ومسطّحٌ مائيٌّ نادر وسط الصحراء صار محطةً للطيور المهاجرة ووجهةً لمن يطلب الهدوء واتّساع الأفق.
pairs.zh: 阿斯法湖（黄湖）是联合国教科文组织世界遗产“哈萨绿洲”的十二处组成部分之一。这片沙漠中央难得一见的水域，如今成了候鸟迁徙途中的歇脚地，也吸引着寻求宁静、向往开阔天际的人们。

pairs.en: Historic Hofuf Trail
pairs.zh: 胡富夫历史路线

pairs.en: Urban heritage at the heart of the old city
pairs.zh: 老城中心的建筑遗产

pairs.en: This trail threads through old Hofuf, between Al-Kut quarter and Souq Al-Qaisariya: a fortress that housed the Ottoman garrison, the house where the people of Al-Ahsa pledged allegiance to King Abdulaziz, Al-Ahsa's first government school, and a covered market that is still very much alive. The stops sit close together and are best explored on foot in the morning or late afternoon.
pairs.zh: 这条路线穿行在胡富夫老城中心，库特区与凯撒利亚集市之间：一座曾为奥斯曼驻军总部的城堡，一处见证哈萨民众向阿卜杜勒阿齐兹国王宣誓效忠的宅邸，哈萨第一所官办学校，还有一座带顶棚的市集，至今依然充满生机。各站相距不远，宜在上午或傍晚步行游览。

pairs.en: Qasr Ibrahim
pairs.zh: 易卜拉欣宫

pairs.en: A fortress on the northern edge of Al-Kut quarter, dating to the 10th century AH (16th century CE) and later used as the Ottoman garrison headquarters in Al-Ahsa. It blends two styles: the religious, seen in the arches and domes of the Al-Qubba Mosque, and the military, expressed in massive towers, soldiers' barracks and horse stables, all built from mud, straw and palm trunks. King Abdulaziz restored Al-Ahsa to the Saudi state in 1331 AH / 1913 CE. The fortress is one of the inscribed UNESCO component parts.
pairs.zh: 这是一座城堡，位于库特区北部，历史可追溯至伊斯兰历 10 世纪（公元 16 世纪），奥斯曼人以它为驻哈萨守军的总部。城堡融两种风格于一体：宗教的一面，见于堡内圆顶清真寺（Qubbah，意为“穹顶”）的拱券与穹顶；军事的一面，见于巨大的塔楼、兵营与马厩。整座建筑以泥土、秸秆和椰枣树干筑成。伊历 1331 年（公元 1913 年），阿卜杜勒阿齐兹国王收复哈萨。易卜拉欣宫是“哈萨绿洲”列入《世界遗产名录》的组成部分之一。

pairs.en: Bayt Al-Bay'ah (Al-Mulla House)
pairs.zh: 效忠之家（拜特·穆拉）

pairs.en: The Al-Mulla family house in Al-Kut quarter, built in 1203 AH / 1788 CE according to the King Abdulaziz Foundation (Darah), is a fine example of traditional Al-Ahsa architecture. King Abdulaziz stayed here on entering Al-Ahsa in 1331 AH / 1913 CE, and it was here that the people of Al-Ahsa pledged their allegiance to him, hence its name, the House of Allegiance. Restored and open to visitors, it bears witness to a defining moment in the unification of the Kingdom.
pairs.zh: 这是穆拉家族在库特区的宅邸，据阿卜杜勒阿齐兹国王基金会记载，建于伊历 1203 年（公元 1788 年），被视为哈萨传统建筑的范例。伊历 1331 年，阿卜杜勒阿齐兹国王进入哈萨时在此下榻，哈萨民众也在这里向他宣誓效忠，宅邸自此人称“效忠之家”。宅邸经过修缮，已可接待访客，见证着王国统一史上的关键一刻。

pairs.en: Al-Amiriya School (House of Culture)
pairs.zh: 阿米里亚学校（文化之家）

pairs.en: Al-Ahsa's first government primary school: classes began in 1356 AH / 1937 CE, and the present building opened officially in Muharram 1360 AH, covering some 1,200 m² around a square courtyard framed by round-arched arcades. Its first class graduated in 1943, and several prominent statesmen studied here. Now known as the House of Culture, it hosts the Heritage Commission's Craftsmen's House programme, launched in 2022.
pairs.zh: 哈萨第一所官办小学，伊历 1356 年（公元 1937 年）开办；现有校舍于伊历 1360 年 1 月（穆哈兰姆月）正式启用，占地约 1200 平方米，方形庭院四周环以半圆拱回廊。首届学生于 1943 年毕业，多位国家要员曾在此就读。如今这里人称“文化之家”（Bait Al-Thaqafa）；2022 年，沙特遗产委员会在此启动了手工艺项目“手工艺人之家”。

pairs.en: Souq Al-Qaisariya
pairs.zh: 凯撒利亚集市

pairs.en: A historic covered market in central Hofuf, built in 1238 AH / 1822 CE. It spreads over more than 15,000 m² with fourteen gates and some 422 shops selling fabrics, traditional clothing, incense and local products. Damaged by fire in 2001, it was rebuilt and fully reopened in late 2013. It is one of the inscribed UNESCO component parts and the natural finale of the trail.
pairs.zh: 胡富夫市中心一座历史悠久、带顶棚的市集，建于伊历 1238 年（公元 1822 年），占地 1.5 万多平方米，设十四座大门、约 422 家店铺，经营布料、传统服饰、熏香和民俗产品。2001 年，市集毁于大火，后经重建，于 2013 年底全面开放。它是“哈萨绿洲”列入《世界遗产名录》的组成部分之一，也是这条路线再好不过的收尾。

pairs.en: Al-Qarah & Jawatha Trail
pairs.zh: 卡拉山与贾瓦塔路线

pairs.en: Caves, pottery and early Islamic heritage in the eastern villages
pairs.zh: 绿洲东部村落的洞穴、陶艺与早期伊斯兰遗迹

pairs.en: This trail heads into the oasis's eastern villages: a mountain of narrow passages and caves, a pottery workshop handed down within one family, and one of the earliest mosques in Islam in eastern Arabia. You will need a car between stops.
pairs.zh: 这条路线带您走进绿洲东部村落：一座藏着狭窄通道与洞穴的山，一间由同一个家族世代相传的陶坊，还有一座坐落在阿拉伯半岛东部的清真寺，是伊斯兰历史上最古老的清真寺之一。各站之间往来需要用车。

pairs.en: Jabal Al-Qarah
pairs.zh: 卡拉山

pairs.en: One of Al-Ahsa's best-known natural landmarks, famous for narrow passages and caves whose temperature stays mild almost all year, so they feel cool in summer and warm in winter. The mountain hosts 'Land of Civilizations', a cultural tourism project partly opened in 2016 that offers a prepared route through the caves with visitor services.
pairs.zh: 哈萨最知名的自然地标之一。山中狭窄的通道与洞穴以温度宜人著称，一年四季几乎恒定：游客盛夏前来觉得凉爽，隆冬前来觉得温暖。山间建有文化旅游项目“文明之地”（Land of Civilizations），2016 年部分开放，洞穴中辟有修整好的游览步道，并提供游客服务。

pairs.en: Dougha Al-Gharash Pottery
pairs.zh: 加拉什家族杜加陶坊

pairs.en: A traditional pottery workshop in Al-Qarah village at the foot of the mountain, run by the Al-Gharash family, who have passed the craft down through generations. Visitors watch vessels being shaped from oasis clay and fired the traditional way, and can take home handmade pieces.
pairs.zh: 卡拉村的一间传统陶坊，就在卡拉山脚下，制陶手艺在加拉什家族中代代相传。在这里，游客可以观看器皿如何以绿洲的黏土塑形，再按传统方法烧制，还能选购手工陶器，留作哈萨之行的纪念。

pairs.en: Jawatha Mosque & Archaeological Site
pairs.zh: 贾瓦塔清真寺及考古遗址

pairs.en: North-east of Hofuf near the village of Al-Kilabiyah, the mosque was built by the Banu Abd Al-Qays in the seventh year of the Hijra after they embraced Islam. Ibn Abbas reported, in Sahih Al-Bukhari, that the first Friday prayer held after the one in the Prophet's Mosque in Madinah was held at the mosque of Abd Al-Qays in Jawatha, which is why it is known as the second mosque in Islam to host the Friday prayer. The mosque and the surrounding archaeological site are both inscribed UNESCO component parts.
pairs.zh: 清真寺位于胡富夫东北方向，靠近基拉比亚村；阿卜杜·盖斯部落自愿归信伊斯兰教后，于伊斯兰历 7 年修建此寺。据《布哈里圣训实录》所载伊本·阿拔斯的传述，在麦地那的先知清真寺举行主麻日聚礼之后，第一次主麻日聚礼是在巴林（此处指历史上的东部沿海地区）贾瓦塔的阿卜杜·盖斯部落清真寺举行的。这座清真寺因此被称为伊斯兰教历史上第二座举行主麻日聚礼的清真寺。清真寺与周边的考古遗址，是“哈萨绿洲”列入《世界遗产名录》的两处组成部分。

pairs.en: Oasis & Springs Trail
pairs.zh: 绿洲与泉眼路线

pairs.en: Rural life among palms and irrigation channels
pairs.zh: 椰枣树与水渠之间的乡村生活

pairs.en: A trail to experience the oasis as its people live it: unbroken palm groves, fields of Hasawi rice, and natural springs that sustained irrigation for centuries before a modern network took over. Early morning is best, and it is wise to arrange visits in advance with farms that welcome guests.
pairs.zh: 沿着这条路线，像当地居民一样体验绿洲：椰枣林连绵成片，稻田里种着哈萨大米，还有一处处天然泉眼——数百年间，灌溉一直仰赖它们，直到现代灌溉网络取而代之。清晨前往最为相宜，建议提前与接待访客的农场约好。

pairs.en: Oasis Groves & Rural Farms
pairs.zh: 绿洲果园与乡村农场

pairs.en: The eastern and northern oases and the Al-Seifa farming area form the heart of the UNESCO-inscribed cultural landscape. At farms that welcome visitors, guests learn how the palms are tended and can witness siram, the annual date harvest, when families and neighbours gather to pick and sort the fruit, Khalas being among the best-known varieties. Early August also marks the planting of red Hasawi rice, one of the oasis's heritage crops.
pairs.zh: 列入联合国教科文组织世界遗产的这片文化景观，以东部绿洲、北部绿洲与赛法农业区为核心。在接待访客的农场里，客人可以了解椰枣树如何养护，并亲眼看到一年一度的椰枣采收季“西拉姆”：各家与邻里合力采摘、分拣椰枣。哈拉斯便是最有名的椰枣品种之一。8 月初，哈萨红米进入种植季；这种红米是绿洲的传统作物之一。

pairs.en: Natural Springs
pairs.zh: 天然泉眼

pairs.en: Springs were the backbone of irrigation in Al-Ahsa before the modern irrigation and drainage project. Their output peaked in 1387 AH / 1967 CE, then declined, and some have dried up. Their waters range from warm, as at Umm Sab'a, which flows through seven channels, and Al-Harrah, to cool, as at Ain Ali, and hot, as at Ain Najm with its sulphurous water, restored by the Heritage Commission. Ain Al-Jawhariya is another historic spring. Flow varies from spring to spring, so check current conditions before visiting.
pairs.zh: 在灌溉与排水工程实施之前，哈萨的灌溉一直仰赖泉眼；出水量在伊斯兰历 1387 年（公元 1967 年）达到顶峰，此后减少，部分泉眼已经干涸。各泉水温不一：温的有分七条水道涌流的艾因乌姆·萨卜阿泉（“艾因”即阿拉伯语“泉”）和艾因哈拉泉；凉的有艾因阿里泉；热的有艾因奈杰姆泉，这处硫磺泉已由沙特遗产委员会修复。艾因焦哈里亚泉也是历史悠久的泉眼之一。各泉水量有别，建议出发前先了解现状。

pairs.en: Al-Asfar Lake & National Park Trail
pairs.zh: 阿斯法湖与国家公园路线

pairs.en: A forest that held back the sands, and a lake among the dunes
pairs.zh: 挡住流沙的森林，沙丘环抱的湖泊

pairs.en: A trail for nature lovers and desert explorers east of the oasis: it begins in a forest planted to shield the oasis from drifting sand and ends at a lake among the dunes where migrating birds rest. Reaching the lake requires a 4x4 and experience of sand driving; going with a guide is recommended.
pairs.zh: 这条路线在绿洲以东，适合喜爱自然与沙漠出游的人：起点是一片森林，为保护绿洲不受流沙侵袭而栽；终点是沙丘间的一片湖，候鸟在此歇脚。前往湖边需要四驱车，还要有沙地驾驶经验，最好有向导同行。

pairs.en: Al-Ahsa National Park
pairs.zh: 哈萨国家公园

pairs.en: In Al-Umran, the park began in 1962 as part of a sand-stabilisation project, with belts of trees planted to stop the dunes advancing on the oasis. As the trees matured it became a forest and a sprawling family park, part of which extends towards the Al-Asfar area, making it a fitting start before heading into the sands.
pairs.zh: 公园位于欧姆兰市，始建于 1962 年，是固沙工程的一部分：当时栽下一道道林带，阻挡沙丘向绿洲推进。随着树木长成，这里变成一片森林，也成了一座开阔的家庭休闲公园，其中一部分向阿斯法一带延伸。深入沙地之前，从这里起步正合适。

pairs.en: Al-Asfar Lake
pairs.zh: 阿斯法湖

pairs.en: A lake ringed by dunes, fed mainly by the oasis's agricultural drainage channels and swelling with winter rain. It is one of the largest bodies of water in the Gulf region. The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture announced the lake’s conversion into a nature reserve covering 326 million m² (SPA, March 2019). It is a resting point for birds migrating north and south, as well as an inscribed UNESCO component part. Locals call it 'kohl of summer, white of winter' for the way its colour shifts between seasons.
pairs.zh: 一片沙丘环抱的湖，湖水主要来自绿洲农场的农业排水渠，冬季湖面随降雨扩大。它被视为海湾地区最大的水域之一。沙特环境水务与农业部宣布将该湖辟为自然保护区，占地 326 平方公里（沙特通讯社，2019 年 3 月）。它是候鸟南北往返迁徙途中的歇脚地，也是“哈萨绿洲”列入《世界遗产名录》的组成部分。当地居民叫它“夏日的黛色，冬日的素白”，说的是湖水的颜色在两季之间变换。

pairs.en: Al-Uqair Coastal Trail
pairs.zh: 乌盖尔海岸路线

pairs.en: Where sea trade met the history of the state
pairs.zh: 海上贸易与国家历史交汇之处

pairs.en: This trail runs east to the Arabian Gulf coast: a port that was the sea gateway for Al-Ahsa and Najd and hosted negotiations that drew the region's borders, followed by a beach for family time. Plan a full day and head back before sunset.
pairs.zh: 这条路线一路向东，直抵海湾沿岸：先到一座港口，它曾是哈萨与内志（沙特中部地区）通向大海的门户，也见证过划定本地区边界的谈判；再到一片适合全家休闲的海滩。建议留出一整天，日落前返程。

pairs.en: Al-Uqair Historic Port
pairs.zh: 乌盖尔古港

pairs.en: Documented by the King Abdulaziz Foundation for Research and Archives (Darah) as the first seaport on the Kingdom's eastern coast along the Arabian Gulf, Al-Uqair was the economic gateway for Al-Ahsa and Najd and the main entry point to eastern and central Arabia until its role faded after the discovery of oil and the building of Dammam port. Its buildings from the reign of King Abdulaziz include the customs and passport houses, the wharf, the khan, the emirate, the fort and the mosque. The founding King received foreign diplomats here, and the 1922 Uqair Conference, which set Najd's borders with Iraq and Kuwait, was held here.
pairs.zh: 据阿卜杜勒阿齐兹国王基金会记载，乌盖尔（Al-Uqair）是王国东部海湾沿岸的第一座海港。它曾是哈萨与内志的经济门户，也是通往王国东部与中部的主要口岸，直到石油发现、达曼港建成，地位才有所下降。港区留有阿卜杜勒阿齐兹国王时期的建筑，包括海关楼、护照楼、码头、商队客栈、埃米尔府、城堡和清真寺。这位开国国王曾把这里用作会见外交使节的场所；1922 年，乌盖尔会议在此召开，划定了内志与伊拉克、科威特的边界。

pairs.en: Al-Uqair Beach
pairs.zh: 乌盖尔海滩

pairs.en: A seafront for strolls and family activities, developed by Al-Ahsa Municipality. The beach also has a modern open-air amphitheatre built by the municipality for events and known locally as the 'Roman Theatre'; it is a contemporary venue, not a Roman antiquity.
pairs.zh: 哈萨市政局开发项目中的一处滨海休闲区，适合散步，也适合全家活动。海滩上还有一座现代露天阶梯剧场，由市政局为举办活动而建，当地人称之为“罗马剧场”；它是一处当代设施，并非古罗马遗迹。

pairs.en: What are the best-known Al-Ahsa Governorate products you can buy online?

pairs.en: The best-known Al-Ahsa Governorate products sold online include premium dates such as Khalas and Shishi, and red Hasawi rice, which is rich in minerals. Handicrafts such as the Hasawi bisht (traditional cloak) and the iqal (headdress cord) also stand out, along with processed Hasawi lumi (dried lime) products. Verified online stores offer these heritage goods to customers in Saudi Arabia and the Gulf states with high quality and guaranteed authenticity.

pairs.en: Where can I buy authentic Al-Ahsa dates online?

pairs.en: Authentic Al-Ahsa dates can be bought from the online stores of verified local factories and farms. The Visit Al-Ahsa directory links to approved platforms offering Khalas and Razeez varieties, which are subject to quality and packing standards, ensuring the harvest reaches shoppers in Saudi Arabia and the Gulf states fresh.

pairs.en: How do I check that a Hasawi bisht is authentic when buying online?

pairs.en: To check the authenticity of a Hasawi bisht when buying online, make sure the store is approved and based in the Al-Ahsa oasis. A genuine bisht is hand-woven with silver or gold zari thread and is regarded as a heritage registered with UNESCO. Specialised, verified stores provide guarantees confirming the precision of the embroidery and the quality of the fabric used.
pairs.zh: 网购哈萨比什特长袍时，要确认店铺已获认证，且位于哈萨绿洲。正宗的比什特长袍由手工织成，配银色或金色扎里线，被视为在联合国教科文组织登记的遗产。专营且经核实的店铺会提供保证，确认刺绣的精细程度和所用面料的品质。

pairs.en: What makes Hasawi rice special, and how is it cooked?
pairs.zh: 哈萨大米有什么特别之处？怎么烹煮？

pairs.en: Hasawi rice is known for its red grain and high nutritional value. It is grown in the Al-Ahsa oasis under high temperatures that give it its distinctive qualities. It needs plenty of water and longer than ordinary rice to cook through fully. Al-Ahsa online stores supply it carefully packaged to preserve its quality.
pairs.zh: 哈萨大米以红色米粒和较高的营养价值著称，种植于哈萨绿洲，在高温下生长，由此形成独特品质。要煮透需要大量的水，用时也比普通大米更长。哈萨网店提供精心包装的哈萨大米，以保持其品质。

pairs.en: The date harvest season in the Al-Ahsa oasis begins in late August with the Ghar and Shishi varieties, and peaks in September and October with the picking of Khalas and Razeez. Buying online during these months lets shoppers get the new, fresh crop directly from the region's approved farms and factories.

pairs.en: How is Hasawi lumi (dried lime) used, and how is it sold online?

pairs.en: Hasawi lumi is used as a staple heritage ingredient that adds a distinctive sour flavour to Saudi and Gulf cooking. The limes are sun-dried with great care, and Al-Ahsa online stores sell them as whole pieces or as ground spice. It is usually added to rice and meat dishes to give them a unique depth of flavour and an authentic taste.
pairs.zh: 哈萨干青柠是一种传统的基础配料，为沙特和海湾地区的菜肴增添独特的酸味。青柠经阳光仔细晒干，哈萨网店以整颗或研磨成粉的形式出售。它通常加入米饭和肉类菜肴中，使其风味更有层次，口味更地道。

pairs.en: What is the best way to store Al-Ahsa dates after they arrive?

pairs.en: To keep the quality of Al-Ahsa dates bought online, store them in airtight containers away from moisture and high heat. It is advisable to keep dates in the fridge if you will eat them soon, or in the freezer for longer periods of up to several months, which keeps the taste and texture of the dates intact and protects them from quick spoilage.
pairs.zh: 为了保持网购哈萨椰枣的品质，请将它们存放在密封容器里，远离潮气和高温。近期要吃的话，建议放冰箱冷藏；想存放更久，可冷冻保存，最长可达数月，这样既能保住椰枣的口味和口感，又能避免很快变质。

pairs.en: Tarafa ibn al-Abd and Al-Ahsa: What the Classical Arabic Sources Say About the Mu'allaqa Poet and Hajar
pairs.zh: 塔拉法·本·阿卜德与哈萨：阿拉伯古籍如何记述这位悬诗诗人与哈杰尔

pairs.en: What links Tarafa ibn al-Abd to Hajar and Al-Ahsa? His end and his grave as told by Ibn Qutaybah and Ibn al-Anbari, what Hajar and al-Bahrayn mean in Yaqut al-Hamawi, and what a visitor finds today.
pairs.zh: 塔拉法·本·阿卜德与哈杰尔、哈萨有何关联？伊本·古太白与伊本·安巴里所述的结局与坟墓，雅库特·哈马维笔下哈杰尔与巴林（此处指历史上的东部沿海地区）的含义，以及今天的访客能看到什么。

pairs.en: Was Tarafa ibn al-Abd born in Al-Ahsa?
pairs.zh: 塔拉法·本·阿卜德出生在哈萨吗？

pairs.en: The classical sources we consulted do not name the place where Tarafa ibn al-Abd was born. What they relate is that the letter of Amr ibn Hind was addressed to his governor over al-Bahrayn and Hajar, al-Bahrayn here being the ancient region between Basra and Oman with Hajar as its chief town, that Tarafa came to the governor while he was at Hajar, and that his grave is at Hajar, as in Ibn al-Anbari's commentary. The statement that he was born in Al-Ahsa Governorate, which used to be known as Hajar, is made by Saudipedia.
pairs.zh: 我们查阅的阿拉伯古籍都没有写明塔拉法·本·阿卜德的出生地。古籍所述的是：阿慕尔·本·杏德的信是写给他派驻巴林与哈杰尔的总督的，这里的巴林指巴士拉与阿曼之间的古老地区，哈杰尔是它的首府；塔拉法来到总督面前时，总督正在哈杰尔；他的坟墓也在哈杰尔，见伊本·安巴里的注释。至于他出生在旧称哈杰尔的哈萨县，这一说法出自沙特百科。

pairs.en: How are Hajar, al-Bahrayn and Al-Ahsa related?
pairs.zh: 哈杰尔、巴林与哈萨是什么关系？

pairs.en: For Yaqut al-Hamawi in Mu'jam al-Buldan, al-Bahrayn is a collective name for lands on the coast of the Sea of India between Basra and Oman, Hajar is a city that is the chief town of al-Bahrayn, and Al-Ahsa is a city in al-Bahrayn that was made the principal town of Hajar. So in the reports about Tarafa, al-Bahrayn is a wide region and Hajar is its chief town.
pairs.zh: 在雅库特·哈马维的《地名辞典》中，巴林是印度海沿岸、巴士拉与阿曼之间一片土地的总称；哈杰尔是一座城，是巴林的首府；哈萨则是巴林境内的一座城，被立为哈杰尔的中心城镇。所以在有关塔拉法的记述里，巴林是一片广阔的地区，哈杰尔是它的首府。

pairs.en: How did Tarafa ibn al-Abd die, and how old was he?
pairs.zh: 塔拉法·本·阿卜德是怎么死的？死时多大？

pairs.en: Ibn Qutaybah relates that Amr ibn Hind wrote Tarafa a letter to his governor over al-Bahrayn and let him believe it contained a reward; he carried it there and was killed. Al-Bahrayn here is the ancient region between Basra and Oman whose chief town is Hajar, as in Yaqut al-Hamawi. There are two reports of his age: he was killed at 20 according to Ibn Qutaybah, and at 26 according to al-Baghdadi in Khizanat al-Adab.
pairs.zh: 据伊本·古太白所述，阿慕尔·本·杏德写了一封信给他派驻巴林的总督，交塔拉法带去，并让他以为信里写的是赏赐；他带着信去了，结果被杀。这里的巴林是巴士拉与阿曼之间的古老地区，首府为哈杰尔，见雅库特·哈马维的记载。关于他的年龄有两种说法：伊本·古太白说他被杀时 20 岁，巴格达迪在《文学宝库》（Khizanat al-Adab）中说是 26 岁。

pairs.en: Is the grave of Tarafa ibn al-Abd known in Al-Ahsa today?
pairs.zh: 今天在哈萨还能找到塔拉法·本·阿卜德的坟墓吗？

pairs.en: Ibn al-Anbari relates that his grave is at Hajar, on a piece of its land belonging to Banu Qays ibn Tha'laba, but the report does not fix the spot, so we do not point visitors to a grave. Nor did we find a permanent landmark bearing his name; what is documented is the Tarafa ibn al-Abd Festival, organised by the Ministry of Culture at King Abdullah Environmental Park from 16 to 24 November 2023, which has ended.
pairs.zh: 据伊本·安巴里所述，他的坟墓在哈杰尔，在那里一块属于盖斯·本·萨阿拉巴部落的土地上；但这则记述没有指明具体位置，所以我们不为访客指认墓址。我们也没有找到以他命名的常设地标；有据可查的是塔拉法·本·阿卜德节，由沙特文化部于 2023 年 11 月 16 日至 24 日在阿卜杜拉国王环境公园举办，现已结束。

pairs.en: We pass on what these books relate in their own words, and we say where they fall silent.
pairs.zh: 古籍怎么说，我们就照原话转述；古籍在哪里沉默，我们也如实说明。

pairs.en: *The image at the top of this article is an imagined, AI-generated depiction, not a portrait of the poet.*
pairs.zh: *文首的图片是人工智能生成的想象画面，并非诗人的肖像。*

pairs.en: Tarafa ibn al-Abd was a Jahili poet, that is, one of the poets from before Islam, of the tribe of Bakr ibn Wa'il
pairs.zh: 塔拉法·本·阿卜德是一位蒙昧时期（Jahili）的诗人，也就是伊斯兰教兴起之前的诗人，出自伯克尔·本·瓦伊勒部落（Bakr ibn Wa'il）

pairs.en: his Mu'allaqa is the long ode on the strength of which the early critics ranked him
pairs.zh: 他的悬诗（Mu'allaqa）就是他那首长诗，早期的诗评家正是凭这首诗为他排定位次

pairs.en: *The injustice of close kin stings a man more sharply than the stroke of a keen Indian sword.*
pairs.zh: *至亲的不公刺痛人心，比锋利的印度剑砍下还要痛。*

pairs.en: The attribution of this verse has long been disputed
pairs.zh: 这联诗的归属历来有争议

pairs.en: His standing is high, though little of his poetry survived.
pairs.zh: 他的地位很高，传世的诗却不多。

pairs.en: belong with the foremost, and were held back only by how little of their poetry is in the hands of the transmitters
pairs.zh: 本应与最前列者并肩，只因他们的诗在传述者手中存下的太少，才落在后面

pairs.en: As for Tarafa, he is the best poet of all for a single poem
pairs.zh: 至于塔拉法，单凭一首诗，就是所有人中最出色的诗人

pairs.en: He is the finest of them in a long ode.
pairs.zh: 论长诗，他是他们当中最好的。

pairs.en: What these books relate is a different link to Hajar, one better anchored in the texts: it lies in his end, not in his birth.
pairs.zh: 这些书讲的，是他与哈杰尔的另一层关联。这层关联在文本里更有依据：它在他的结局里，不在他的出生上。

pairs.en: to his governor over al-Bahrayn and Hajar
pairs.zh: 写给他派驻巴林与哈杰尔的总督

pairs.en: Al-Bahrayn here is a wide ancient region whose chief town is Hajar; it is explained in the section on the old names below.
pairs.zh: 这里的巴林是一片广阔的古老地区，首府为哈杰尔；下文讲旧地名的一节另有说明。

pairs.en: Then Tarafa travelled on until he came to the governor of al-Bahrayn, who was at Hajar
pairs.zh: 随后塔拉法一路前行，来到巴林总督面前，总督当时在哈杰尔

pairs.en: His grave today is at Hajar, on a piece of its land belonging to Banu Qays ibn Tha'laba
pairs.zh: 他的坟墓如今在哈杰尔，在那里一块属于盖斯·本·萨阿拉巴部落的土地上

pairs.en: "Today" here is the narrator's day, not ours.
pairs.zh: 这里的“如今”指讲述者那时，不是我们的今天。

pairs.en: a great many people of Abd al-Qays, Bakr ibn Wa'il and Tamim, living in its open country
pairs.zh: 许多阿卜杜·盖斯部落、伯克尔·本·瓦伊勒部落和泰米姆部落的人，住在它的旷野之中

pairs.en: We report it as Saudipedia's statement, and set beside it the silence of the early sources.
pairs.zh: 我们把它作为沙特百科的说法转述，并拿早期古籍的沉默与它对照。

pairs.en: the sahifa being the sealed letter that Tarafa and al-Mutalammis each carried
pairs.zh: sahifa 指的是塔拉法与穆塔莱米斯各自带着的那封加了封印的信

pairs.en: bold in satirising them and in satirising others
pairs.zh: 敢于讥讽他们，也敢于讥讽别人

pairs.en: but Tarafa refused to break the king's seal
pairs.zh: 但塔拉法不肯拆开国王的封印

pairs.en: al-Mutalammis threw the letter into the river of al-Hira and fled to Syria
pairs.zh: 穆塔莱米斯把信扔进希拉的河里，逃往黎凡特

pairs.en: Flee this very night, for I have been ordered to kill you.
pairs.zh: 今夜就逃吧，我已奉命杀你。

pairs.en: By God, I will never do that.
pairs.zh: 凭神起誓，我绝不这样做。

pairs.en: the governor held himself above killing him and wrote to the king that he would not kill the man
pairs.zh: 总督觉得杀他有失身份，不肯下手，并写信告诉国王，这个人他不杀

pairs.en: We do not choose between them.
pairs.zh: 我们不在其间取舍。

pairs.en: That is why the story is best read as a report handed down by transmitters.
pairs.zh: 正因如此，这个故事最好当作传述者所传的一则记述来读。

pairs.en: embellished, polished storytelling related by the chroniclers
pairs.zh: 掌故家讲述的、经过润饰雕琢的故事

pairs.en: that al-Bahrayn in that period was subject to the king of al-Hira, and that its ruler was a governor for Amr ibn Hind
pairs.zh: 那一时期的巴林隶属于希拉国王，其统治者是阿慕尔·本·杏德的总督

pairs.en: He was killed at 20 years of age, and so he is called the 20-year-old.
pairs.zh: 他被杀时 20 岁，所以人称‘那个 20 岁的人’。

pairs.en: *I see death choosing out the generous, and picking for itself the best of the tight-fisted miser's wealth.*
pairs.zh: *我看见死亡专挑慷慨之人，又从吝啬守财者的财产里拣走最好的。*

pairs.en: a collective name for lands on the coast of the Sea of India between Basra and Oman
pairs.zh: 印度海沿岸、巴士拉与阿曼之间一片土地的总称

pairs.en: al-Khatt, al-Qatif, al-Ara, Hajar, Baynuna, al-Zara, Jawatha, al-Sabur, Darin and al-Ghaba
pairs.zh: 哈特、盖提夫、阿腊（al-Ara）、哈杰尔、拜努纳、扎拉、贾瓦塔、萨布尔、达林和加巴

pairs.en: the principal town of Hajar is al-Safa and al-Mushaqar
pairs.zh: 哈杰尔的中心城镇是萨法与穆沙卡尔

pairs.en: a city, and it is the chief town of al-Bahrayn
pairs.zh: 一座城，是巴林的首府

pairs.en: It is also said that the whole district of al-Bahrayn is Hajar, and that is the correct view.
pairs.zh: 也有人说，整个巴林地区都叫哈杰尔，这才是正确的说法。

pairs.en: Al-Ahsa: a city in al-Bahrayn, well known and famous
pairs.zh: 哈萨：巴林的一座城，广为人知，颇有名气

pairs.en: which is the water that the ground soaks up from the sand
pairs.zh: 也就是大地从沙中吸进去的水

pairs.en: in the area of its villages there is a small lake at the gate of Al-Ahsa
pairs.zh: 在它的村落一带，哈萨的城门前有一个小湖

pairs.en: *As if the litters of the Malikite woman, at morning, were great ships in the broad channels of Dad,*
pairs.zh: *清晨，马利克部落女子的驼轿，仿佛达德宽阔水道上的一艘艘大船，*

pairs.en: *Adawli ships, or ships of Ibn Yamin, which the sailor now lets stray and now steers true,*
pairs.zh: *是阿道利船，或是伊本·亚敏（Ibn Yamin）的船，水手驾着它时而偏航，时而对准航向，*

pairs.en: *her prow cleaving the ripples of the water as a player of the game of fiyal parts the dust with his hand.*
pairs.zh: *船首劈开水面的涟漪，一如玩“菲亚勒”（fiyal）游戏的人用手把沙土分开。*

pairs.en: And Ibn Yamin: a sailor from the people of Hajar as well.
pairs.zh: 伊本·亚敏：同样是哈杰尔人，是一位水手。

pairs.en: So the name of Hajar is present in the commentary on the Mu'allaqa, not in the wording of the verse.
pairs.zh: 可见哈杰尔之名出现在悬诗的注释里，而不在这联诗的字面上。

pairs.en: what Tarafa was first to say and others took from him
pairs.zh: 塔拉法最先说出、后人从他那里袭用的诗

pairs.en: A poet who knows how a ship's prow parts the water: an image that suits a region where the sands meet the coast.
pairs.zh: 一位懂得船首如何分开水面的诗人：这样的意象，正配得上一片沙地与海岸相接的地区。

pairs.en: Nor did we find a street, a monument or a recurring event in Al-Ahsa that carries his name.
pairs.zh: 我们也没有在哈萨找到以他命名的街道、纪念碑或定期举办的活动。

pairs.en: There is one documented trace, and it has passed
pairs.zh: 有据可查的痕迹只有一处，而且已成过去

pairs.en: to strengthen the ties between the early Arab poets and their geographical sites
pairs.zh: 加强早期阿拉伯诗人与其所在地理位置之间的联系

pairs.en: What remains for you:
pairs.zh: 今天您还能看到的：

pairs.en: We link name to name, and do not claim that the poet stood at either of them.
pairs.zh: 我们只是以地名对应地名，并不声称诗人到过其中任何一处。

pairs.en: a link of scenery, not of record
pairs.zh: 这是景致上的联系，不是史料上的联系

pairs.en: The Bottom Line
pairs.zh: 归根结底

pairs.en: He was killed young: at 20 in one report, and at 26 in another.
pairs.zh: 他年纪轻轻就被杀了：一说 20 岁，另一说 26 岁。

pairs.en: Read the opening of the Mu'allaqa once more while you are in the oasis.
pairs.zh: 您身在绿洲时，不妨把悬诗的开篇再读一遍。

pairs.en: The ruins the poet wept over are not on our map, but Hajar, where the books say his road ended, is in Yaqut an old name for this very district.
pairs.zh: 诗人为之落泪的营地遗迹不在我们的地图上，但古籍说他的路在哈杰尔走到了尽头，而在雅库特笔下，哈杰尔正是这一带的一个旧名。

pairs.en: Listed in order of appearance. The classical works are cited from their pages in Al-Maktaba Al-Shamela, with volume and page as shown there. Links checked on 2026-10-10.
pairs.zh: 按在文中出现的先后排列。古籍均引自沙米拉文库（Al-Maktaba Al-Shamela）中的相应页面，卷次与页码以该处所示为准。链接核对日期：2026-10-10。

pairs.en: Put plainly, it cooks in a tannour buried in a pit in the ground.
pairs.zh: 说得直白些：曼迪是在坦努尔泥炉里烹熟的，泥炉就埋在地下的土坑里。
pairs.note: food-amend 2026-10-15 (قرار إياد): الجملة الصريحة بعد الصورة الشعرية؛ 烹熟 محايد = يُنضَج (لا 烤)؛ 埋…地下的土坑 = مدفون في حفرة بالأرض (لا 地炉/馕坑)؛ أول ذكر 坦努尔泥炉 هنا.

pairs.en: Balaleet is served with an egg omelette.
pairs.zh: 巴拉利特与煎蛋饼一同上桌。
pairs.note: food-amend 2026-10-15 (قرار إياد): بلا «通常» ولا عدد ولا هيئة — المصدر لا يقولها.

pairs.en: Al-Ahsa’s own dates melt into wheat flour over a gentle flame, stirred patiently until the asida thickens, then crowned with ghee, which gives it its gleam, and a scatter of black pepper that kindles its warmth.
pairs.zh: 哈萨本地的椰枣与小麦面粉在文火上慢慢交融，耐心搅拌至稠滑，最后浇上酥油，泛起油亮的光泽，再撒一撮黑胡椒，暖意顿生。
pairs.note: food-amend 2026-10-15 (قرار إياد): لا زعفران؛ اللمعان من السمن («浇上酥油，泛起油亮的光泽» لا «让它泛出»).

pairs.en: A soft porridge eaten by the spoonful, it is the Hasawi winter sweet a family gathers around on cold nights.
pairs.zh: 这道椰枣阿西达（Asida）呈柔软的糊状，用勺舀着吃，是哈萨的冬日甜点——寒夜里，一家人围坐着分食一盘。
pairs.note: food-amend 2026-10-15 (قرار إياد): «عصيدةٌ ليّنة تُغرَف» = 呈柔软的糊状，用勺舀着吃.

pairs.en: Small grains cooked in water and sweetened with sugar, melting over the flame until they turn into a translucent jewel shimmering with saffron and cardamom.
pairs.zh: 细小的西米加清水和糖，在火上慢慢煮至晶莹剔透，化作透亮的甜羹，透着藏红花的色泽、小豆蔻的清香。
pairs.note: food-amend 2026-10-15 (قرار إياد): 清水 لا حليب، 糖 بلا نوع ولا كمية؛ الزعفران والهيل باقيان.

pairs.en: Also known as “red bread”.
pairs.zh: 当地也称它为“红面包”。
pairs.note: food-amend 2026-10-15 (قرار إياد): حُذفت النقحرة (khubz ahmar)؛ 红面包 باقٍ (C5b).

pairs.en: Saudi tourist eVisa: who is it for?
pairs.zh: 沙特旅游电子签证：适合哪些人？

pairs.en: Who is this visa for?
pairs.zh: 这种签证适合谁？

pairs.en: Citizens of the eligible countries listed on the platform; holders of a valid Schengen, US or UK visit visa; permanent residents of the US, the EU or the UK; and residents of GCC countries. It covers tourism, attending events, visiting relatives and Umrah. It does not cover Hajj, work or study.
pairs.zh: 平台所列符合条件国家的公民；持有有效的申根、美国或英国访问签证者；美国、欧盟或英国的永久居民；以及海合会国家居民。可用于旅游、参加活动、探亲与副朝；不可用于朝觐、工作或学习。

pairs.en: Validity and length of stay:
pairs.zh: 有效期与停留时长：

pairs.en: One year from the date of issue, multiple entry, with a stay of up to 3 months.
pairs.zh: 自签发之日起 1 年有效，多次入境，停留最长 3 个月。

pairs.en: Frequently asked questions about the Saudi visit visa
pairs.zh: 沙特访问签证常见问题

pairs.en: How long is the Saudi tourist eVisa valid?
pairs.zh: 沙特旅游电子签证有效期多久？

pairs.en: It is valid for one year from the date of issue with multiple entry, and each stay can last up to 3 months.
pairs.zh: 自签发之日起 1 年有效，多次入境，每次停留最长 3 个月。

pairs.en: Can the tourist eVisa be extended?
pairs.zh: 旅游电子签证可以延期吗？

pairs.en: No. If it expires before you enter the Kingdom, a new application is required.
pairs.zh: 不可以。如果签证在您入境沙特前过期，须重新申请。

pairs.en: Can I work on a tourist visa?

pairs.zh: 不可以。旅游签证用于旅游、参加活动、副朝和探亲，不允许工作或学习。

pairs.en: Kafu Nights is an annual Ramadan community festival organised by King Faisal University in Al-Ahsa Governorate; its first edition was held in 2024. “Kafu” comes from an Arabic verb meaning “to be rewarded”: to earn reward and praise. Among the highlights of the nights is the “Ghabqa”, a popular meal and social custom held on the nights of the holy month of Ramadan in the Arab Gulf states.
pairs.zh: 卡夫之夜（Kafu Nights）是一年一度的斋月社区节庆，由费萨尔国王大学在哈萨县主办，首届于 2024 年举行。“卡夫”一词源自阿拉伯语动词，意为“受到奖赏”，即赢得奖赏与赞誉。卡夫之夜的亮点活动之一是“盖布加”晚宴。“盖布加”是海湾阿拉伯国家的一种民间聚餐与社交习俗，在神圣斋月的夜晚举行。

pairs.en: Palm Village is a seasonal destination organised by the Al-Ahsa Development Authority and Al-Ahsa Municipality amid the palm groves of the Al-Ahsa Oasis. It celebrates the palm and everything that grows from it: the date and its many products, the farmers who tend it, and the crafts woven from its fronds, in one place where shopping, tasting and heritage sit side by side. A visit works as a tour of several stops, so each visitor can pick what suits their interests and their time.
pairs.zh: 椰枣村是一项季节性活动，由哈萨发展管理局、哈萨市政局主办，设在哈萨绿洲的椰枣林间。这里以椰枣树为主题，汇聚椰枣与琳琅满目的椰枣制品、悉心照料椰枣树的农民，以及用棕榈叶编织的手工艺品。购物、品尝和感受传统文化，在这里可以一次完成。整个园区可分几处依次游览，每位访客都能按自己的兴趣和行程时间自由选择。
pairs.note: palm-village-page

pairs.en: The project was inaugurated in December 2024 by HRH Prince Saud bin Nayef bin Abdulaziz, Emir of the Eastern Province, as a lasting venue for palm and date products and the events around them. HH Prince Saud bin Talal bin Badr, Governor of Al-Ahsa, opened it on the evening of Tuesday 22 April 2025 on a site of more than 50,000 square metres. That first season coincided with the Year of Handicrafts 2025 and included an area for craftsmen and workshops; about 5,000 visitors a day were expected, an estimate announced at the opening rather than a recorded attendance figure.
pairs.zh: 2024 年 12 月，东部省省长沙特·本·纳伊夫·本·阿卜杜勒阿齐兹王子宣布启动该项目，旨在为椰枣树与椰枣产品及配套活动建立一处长期固定的场地。2025 年 4 月 22 日（星期二）晚，哈萨县县长沙特·本·塔拉勒·本·巴德尔王子主持开幕，场地面积 50000 多平方米。首届恰逢“2025 手工艺年”，设有手工艺人与工作坊专区；开幕时预计日均访客约 5000 人，这是当时公布的预估数字，而非实际统计的到访人数。
pairs.note: palm-village-page

pairs.en: The second edition opened on 27 January 2026 under the patronage of the Emir of the Eastern Province, opened by HRH Prince Saud bin Bandar bin Abdulaziz, Deputy Emir of the Eastern Province, in the presence of the Governor of Al-Ahsa, and ran for two months. It covered 90,000 square metres, with 21 shops for dates and date products, 19 restaurants and cafés, 5 shops for Hasawi rural products and 7 pavilions for crafts made from the palm. Its programme included a Palm Museum on palm and date varieties and their history, an interactive theatre, folk arts, culture houses for arts, literature, crafts and folk heritage, and activities for children. These figures belong to the second edition; facilities may change from one edition to the next.
pairs.zh: 第二届于 2026 年 1 月 27 日在东部省省长的支持下开幕，由东部省副省长沙特·本·班达尔·本·阿卜杜勒阿齐兹王子主持，哈萨县县长出席，展期两个月。场地面积 90000 平方米，设有 21 家椰枣及椰枣制品商店、19 家餐厅与咖啡馆、5 家哈萨乡村产品商店，以及 7 座展出椰枣树材质手工艺品的展馆。这一届的活动内容包括：椰枣树博物馆（介绍椰枣树和椰枣的品种及其历史）、互动剧场、民间艺术、文化屋（汇集艺术、文学、手工艺与民间传统），以及儿童活动。以上为第二届的数据，各届设施可能有所不同。
pairs.note: palm-village-page
